summary: The three tickets build against the shared contract in models.py and api.ts, change one file each, and their tests pass. Two rule gaps are worth fixing before the pilot; nothing here blocks the demo.

findings.message: The address check compares only the first number. For 'Flat 3, 14 Larkspur Row' that is the flat number, so a document showing a different street number would still pass. Compare every number in the first line.

findings.rule: Trust: never mark a correct value as wrong
findings.message: page_text joins the cited words in the order the model cited them. A correct value cited out of reading order is marked not_on_page. Sort the cited words by position (top, then left) before joining.
The boxes are clickable but have no accessible name. Add an aria-label with the field label and confidence, so a screen reader announces them.
